scientific_interpretation: With autonomous assurance disabled, the existing local-support route can synthetically rescue the sign of effective service and reproduction in 2 of 89 matched decline contrasts, but it worsens 37 of those same contrasts. The route therefore acts primarily as a branch allocator/context modifier rather than a dedicated buffering process. The two sign rescues are too sparse to call robust without an independently frozen stochastic block.
next_gate: Run one predeclared non-overlapping seed block with the identical support OFF/ON design. Do not search seeds or change support strength after observing the two sign rescues.
claim_boundary: This is synthetic capability only. It does not identify service redundancy or network buffering in Guaiacum or any other empirical island system.
